items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: Uncle Billy King has got a big floor show here

ctx.x: said if we can get together where we can use two piano players I says I'll accept the proposition I says the bigger place as Lincoln Garden is and Uncle Billy King has got a big floor show here I said you need two piano players to keep the music going I said you see now here will be the way to arrange it my piano player has never had no experience playing no show that's out she's got to have that training Marie Lucas knows the show she can arrange and write she can direct she can play trombone I keep the people…
and singing and I'll hold the crowd
